WoW: Forever

Warlock

Warlock levels behind a demon. Forever split damage curses into Banes, so you hold one Bane and one Curse on a target at the same time, and Life TapLife TapLevel 6 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantConverts 30 Health into 30 Mana for you. Spirit increases the amount converted. now grows with your Spirit.

WoW: Forever · Updated November 13, 2026 · Client build 1.60.1.70938 · Null Ossuary

A guide to the live game, 1 to 60, on client 1.60.1.70938 with Blizzard's hotfixes through November 12. Mechanics come from Blizzard's posts and the client. Training levels are foreverchanges.pro's reading of the client. Talent orders are Wowhead's and Icy Veins' published levelling builds, named where used. What is still thin: no raid opens until December 9, so no raid log exists, and every level-60 rotation here is a guide's or a sim's. Blizzard tunes classes on Tuesdays. Hover tooltips read the base client and can lag a hotfix: where one differs from the text here, the text is right.

Blizzard's own summary says all three "now do damage to compete with any other spellcaster, with three completely different styles to conduct that competition." That is Blizzard on its own class. No raid log exists to check it.

Your demon scales with your gear in every spec. Blizzard's deep dive: "pets now scale from their summoner's stats." Blizzard gives one ratio, 2 Health per point of your Stamina. Wowhead adds that the demon scales from your Spell Power and uses your Hit and your spell critical strike chance; it gives no ratios.

Is Warlock for you?

Play Warlock if you do not mind tracking a pet, a handful of timers and two resources at once.

Strengths

  • A permanent pet from level 1, and one that tanks from the Voidwalker quest at 10
  • Life TapLife TapLevel 6 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantConverts 30 Health into 30 Mana for you. Spirit increases the amount converted. trades health for mana and Drain LifeDrain LifeLevel 14 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost55 ManaRange20 yd rangeDuration5 secTransfers 10 health every 1 second from the target to the caster. Lasts 5 sec. trades it back, so you rarely sit to drink
  • Instant damage-over-time effects let you fight two enemies at once, one of them feared

Weaknesses

  • Five things to track at once: timers, pet, health, mana and shards
  • Demon abilities are trained from Grimoires, bought separately from your own spells, and every rank costs gold. Blizzard prices your trainer lower to cover what it expects the Grimoires to cost
  • Soul shards still do not stack

New to this class?

Is the rotation simple? Send the demon, apply one to three timed effects, then fill with a wand or Drain LifeDrain LifeLevel 14 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost55 ManaRange20 yd rangeDuration5 secTransfers 10 health every 1 second from the target to the caster. Lasts 5 sec..

Is it forgiving? The demon takes the first hits, and Drain LifeDrain LifeLevel 14 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost55 ManaRange20 yd rangeDuration5 secTransfers 10 health every 1 second from the target to the caster. Lasts 5 sec. turns your damage back into health.

What changed at launch? Demons got less Health from your Stamina on November 2, then two Health buffs on November 6 and 10. See "Which demon, when" below.

Does it need a group? No. Create HealthstoneCreate HealthstoneLevel 10 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 5Cast3 sec castCost95 ManaCreates a Minor Healthstone that can be used to instantly restore 120 health. Conjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes. at 10 gives you your own emergency heal.

If an effect is devoured, the Felhunter will be healed for 258., for casters.

Demons are less sturdy than in the beta, and Blizzard has patched that twice. On November 2 the Health a demon gets from your Stamina fell from 7.5 a point to 2. On November 6 the Voidwalker gained about 40 base Health at every level. On November 10 the Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus and Incubus gained about 15% base Health. One creator reported that a level-18 Voidwalker could barely hold two enemies on November 9, before the second buff. That is one player's report, unconfirmed.

Your current demon is stunned while you summon a new one, on Blizzard's development notes, so change demons between pulls.

Demonic SacrificeDemonic SacrificeSpell · ShadowCastInstantRange100 yd rangeWhen activated, sacrifices your summoned Demon to enhance the opposing aspect of your power, granting you an effect that lasts 7200 sec. The effect is canceled if any Demon is summoned. Imp: Increases your Shadow damage by 15%. Voidwalker: Restores 2% of your total Mana every 4 sec. Succubus/Incubus: Increases your Fire damage by 15%. Felhunter: Restores 3% of your total Health every 4 sec. lasts two hours and its damage bonuses are swapped from Classic: sacrificing the Imp gives +15% Shadow, the Succubus or Incubus +15% Fire. The Voidwalker restores 2% of your Mana every 4 seconds and the Felhunter 3% of your Health. It is the 11-point Demonology milestone, level 20 at the earliest.

Wowhead's raid pages add that demons take 50% less damage from boss area effects.

Which race

Read this section in proportion. Race sits behind spec, gear and knowing your rotation (ours, not a source's).

Warlock has five playable races in Forever: Human and Gnome on the Alliance, Orc and Undead on the Horde, plus the newly playable Troll. Icy Veins names Orc for the Horde and Human for the Alliance on all three spec pages (November 9).

The racials that break crowd control are PvP tools: Will of the ForsakenWill of the ForsakenTalentCastInstantCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration0.1 secInstantly removes all Charm, Fear and Sleep effects. (Gnome, roots and snares) and Will to SurviveWill to SurviveTalentCastInstantCooldown180 sec cooldownInstantly removes all Stun effects. (Human, stuns).

Quality of life

  • Soul shards are a Reagent now. Forever added a reagent bag slot, so your soul bag no longer takes one of your four bags. They still do not stack.
  • Class quests give you your demons: Imp in the starting zone, Voidwalker at 10, Succubus and Incubus at 20, Felhunter at 30.
  • Ritual of SummoningRitual of SummoningLevel 20 · Spell · ShadowCast5 sec castCost300 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration600 secBegins a ritual that summons the targeted group member. Requires the caster and 2 additional party members to complete the ritual. In order to participate, all players must be out of combat and right-click the portal and not move until the ritual is complete. is the only summon. Wowhead notes that Meeting Stones do not summon in Forever. It needs you and two party members, and a Soul Shard.
  • Budget for Grimoires. Blizzard's notes put every class's training from 1 to 60 at 206 to 207 gold, and take the expected Grimoire costs off the Warlock's share.
  • Talents come one per level from 10, 51 in all. Rows open at 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35 and 40. The one-point milestones sit at 11, 16, 21 and 31 points. What changed from Classic

ChangeWhat it means for you
Damage curses became BanesOnly one Bane per Warlock on a target, though a Bane and a Curse coexist. Anything that worked on Curses works on Banes
Timed damage can critCritical strike is a real stat for every spec. Wowhead: damage-over-time is calculated at each tick, not at the cast, so a buff applies to effects already running
Life TapLife TapLevel 6 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantConverts 30 Health into 30 Mana for you. Spirit increases the amount converted. scales with SpiritEach point of Spirit adds 1 Mana to every tap. Both guide sites still rank Spirit below every damage stat
Curse of the ElementsCurse of the ElementsLevel 20 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost50 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration300 secCurses the target for 300 sec, reducing Magic resistances by 30 and increases Magic damage taken by 4%. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target. at 20, all magic schoolsIt was level 32 and Fire and Frost only
Firestone and Spellstone are weapon imbuesThey stack with Wizard Oil
Hit cap is 17% against raid bossesWowhead: the 1% miss chance that could never be removed is gone. Against an enemy of your own level you need 4%
Soul shards are reagents with their own bag slotStill do not stack
The 16-debuff limit: unknownBlizzard has not said whether it survives, and no raid is open to test it. Do not plan slots around either answer
